name: Syndrome with Limb Duplication, Polydactyly, Syndactyly, and/or Hyperphalangy
aliases: Limb Duplication and Digit Anomaly Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of limb duplication affecting one or more limbs
Presence of supernumerary digits (polydactyly) on hands and/or feet
Syndactyly (fusion of digits) and/or hyperphalangy (extra phalanges) in affected limbs

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of limb duplication plus either polydactyly or syndactyly/hyperphalangy at birth
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical based on limb malformations; genetic testing may assist but no specific gene identified.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Limb duplication involving upper and/or lower extremities
searchTerms: extra limb parts on arms or legs
limb duplication with extra fingers or toes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Polydactyly with fully formed supernumerary digits
searchTerms: extra fully formed fingers or toes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Syndactyly or fusion of adjacent digits
searchTerms: fused or webbed fingers or toes

common.symptomName: Hyperphalangy with extra phalanges in digits
searchTerms: extra finger bones causing long digits

common.symptomName: Reduced range of motion in affected limbs
Asymmetry of limb length or size
Mild joint contractures in duplicated limbs
searchTerms: mild stiff joints in extra limbs
limited joint movement in duplicated limbs

occasional.symptomName: Mild skin webbing between digits beyond syndactyly
searchTerms: skin webbing between fingers or toes beyond normal fusion
abnormal nails on extra fingers or toes
unusual nail growth on extra digits

occasional.symptomName: Muscle hypoplasia in duplicated limb segments
searchTerms: underdeveloped muscles in extra limb parts

occasional.symptomName: Mild limb edema due to vascular anomalies
searchTerms: mild swelling in limbs from blood vessel issues
limb edema due to vascular problems

rare.symptomName: Neurological deficits related to limb anomalies
searchTerms: neurological issues affecting arms or legs

rare.symptomName: Respiratory complications secondary to thoracic malformations
searchTerms: respiratory issues due to thoracic abnormalities
lung complications caused by chest deformities

imaging: X-ray demonstrating limb duplication, polydactyly, syndactyly, and hyperphalangy
MRI may delineate soft tissue and vascular anatomy of duplicated limbs
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; possible sporadic or heterogeneous inheritance
other: Clinical examination revealing congenital limb malformations

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated polydactyly or syndactyly without duplication
Absence rather than duplication of digits

redFlags: Presence of associated cardiac or neurological anomalies
Rapid progression of limb swelling or vascular compromise
references: Orphanet: Syndrome with limb duplication, polydactyly, syndactyly, and/or hyperphalangy (ORPHA:294959)
Smith's Recognizable Patterns of Human Malformation, 7th Edition
